Narratif généré : CodeSystem SpenserUnitProperty

This case-sensitive code system http://costateixeira.github.io/spenser/CodeSystem/SpenserUnitProperty defines the following codes:

CodeAffichageDéfinition
server-url Order serverThe FHIR base URL the unit polls for orders.
order-mode Order modeWhich routes make an order actionable for this unit: both, tag or task.
order-query Order searchExtra search parameters for tagged orders.
task-query Task searchExtra search parameters for Tasks.
poll-enabled PollingWhether the unit checks the order server on its own.
poll-seconds Poll intervalSeconds between checks.
write-back Write backWhether the unit reports dispenses and closes orders on the server.
give-up-on-stock-empty Give up when emptyWhether an order for an empty lane is abandoned rather than retried after a refill.
update-mode Update modenotify, or install firmware updates on its own.
update-check-minutes Update check intervalMinutes between looks at the release manifest.
stock-dark Dark stockPieces of dark chocolate the unit believes it holds.
stock-milk Milk stockPieces of milk chocolate the unit believes it holds.
last-check Last checkWhat the last order check reported.
last-configuration Last configurationWhat the last configuration Task did.
ssid Wi-Fi networkThe Wi-Fi network the unit is on.
ip-address IP addressThe unit's address on its own network.
rssi SignalWi-Fi signal strength, in dBm.
largest-free-block Largest free blockThe largest block of free memory, in bytes. A TLS connection needs about 40 KB in one piece.

name: SpenserUnitProperty
title: Spenser Unit Properties
description: What a Spenser unit reports about itself in Device.property on the order server: its settings and its state. Written on the first check against a server, after a change of settings, and every ten minutes.
